{{Quote|We were in the main conference room on the officer's deck—Chief Moradim [sic] Bast, Colonel Wulff [sic] Yularen, Chief Siward Cass, General Trech Molock, General Hurst Romodi, Commander Cassio Tagge, and myself—discussing the relative threat levels facing our respective commands.|Admiral Conan Motti mentions Molock in his incident report|<ref name="AIR" />}}
[[General]] '''Trech Molock''' was a [[human]] individual who served in the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. In [[1 BBY]], Molock attended a meeting of the [[Joint Chiefs of the Imperial Military]] in a [[Death Star conference room|conference room]] on board the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station]]. At the meeting, Molock heard [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] announce the dissolution of the [[Imperial Senate]] and witnessed the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] use [[the Force]] to [[Telekinesis|choke]] [[Admiral]] [[Conan Antonio Motti]] until Tarkin ordered the [[Sith Lord]] to stop.

==Biography==
Trech Molock<ref name="AIR" /> was a [[human]] individual<ref name="Episode IV" />who held the [[military rank]] of [[general]] within the [[Imperial Military|armed forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="AIR" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|IV|1}}</ref> Molock attended a meeting of the [[Joint Chiefs of the Imperial Military]] that was held in the [[Death Star conference room|main conference room]] on the [[officer's deck]] of the semi-operational Imperial [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station]]. The meeting was called by [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]], but Molock arrived before the Grand Moff and sat with General [[Moradmin Bast]], [[Colonel]] [[Wullf Yularen]], Chief [[Siward Cass]], General [[Hurst Romodi]], General [[Cassio Tagge]], and [[Admiral]] [[Conan Antonio Motti]] discussing the relative threats that each of their respective commands faced.<ref name="AIR" /> This led to Tagge and Motti arguing about the threat posed to the [[battle station]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], but they were interrupted by the arrival of Tarkin and the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], with Tarkin announcing that the [[Imperial Senate]] had been dissolved.<ref name="Episode IV" />

Molock remained silent as Tagge and Tarkin discussed the dissolution and then the Alliance's recent [[Battle of Scarif|theft]] of a set of [[Death Star plans|plans]] for the [[Death Star]] that they could use to make an attack. Motti dismissed the possibility of a successful attack on the station, claiming it was by then the ultimate power in [[the galaxy]], but Vader chastised him and stated that [[the Force]] was more powerful. The admiral then criticized Vader' devotion to the Force, but the [[Sith Lord]] cut him off by [[Telekinesis|choking]] Motti from across the room using the Force. Molock and the others watched the admiral struggle until Tarkin ordered Vader to release Motti and stated that they would soon destroy the Alliance.<ref name="Episode IV" /> The next [[Standard day|day]], Motti mentioned Molock in an incident report about Vader's actions at the meeting that he submitted to [[Imperial High Command]].<ref name="AIR" /> The Death Star was shortly subsequently destroyed at the [[Battle of Yavin]] by the Rebel Alliance, resulting in the [[death]]s of Tarkin,<ref name="Episode IV" /> Motti,<ref name="Motti">{{SWE|characters|admiral-motti|Admiral Motti}}</ref> Yularen,<ref name="Life Debt">''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]''</ref> Bast, and many others.<ref name="Episode IV" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Leading–and already noted–figures such as Tarkin, Motti, Yularen, and Romodi were all killed onboard the Death Star, along with others such as General Trech Molock, Officer Siward Cass, and Chief Moradmin Bast.|Beaumont Kin, on the Empire's losses|<ref name="Rise" />}}
In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="RiseDate">{{RiseAndFallDate}}</ref> the [[historian]] and [[Resistance]] paramilitary member [[Beaumont Kin]] mentioned Molock in<ref name="Rise" /> his<ref name="TROSVD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[book]] ''[[The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''. There, Kin stated that with the loss of leading figures such as Tarkin, Motti, Yularen, Romodi and others such as Molock, Cass, and Bast all perishing during the destruction of the Death Star, coupled with the Imperial losses of Director Krennic during the [[Battle of Scarif]] and [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] during the [[Liberation of Lothal|Battle of Lothal]], the Empire had many of its leading military commanders and figures culled.<ref name="Rise" />

==Personality and traits==
Trech Molock had light skin and [[Color|reddish-brown]] [[hair]].<ref name="Episode IV" /> Molock was considered by Kin as one of the Empire's leading military figures and commanders.<ref name="Rise" />

==Equipment==
While in the meeting on the Death Star, Molock wore a gray [[Imperial officer's uniform]] with a [[rank insignia plaque]] that showed six red squares.<ref name="Episode IV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trech Molock first appeared as an unnamed background character in the [[1977]] original ''[[Star Wars]]'' film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']],<ref name="Episode IV" /> whom the fan website [http://www.aveleyman.com Aveleyman] identifies as [[Charlie Gray]],<ref name="Aveleyman">
{{WebCite|url=http://www.aveleyman.com/ActorCredit.aspx?ActorID=103471|text=Aveleyman - Charlie Gray|archivedate=20190307182858}}</ref> an actor listed as an Imperial Bureaucrat in [[Ann Skinner]]'s continuity notes.<ref name="ImperialGathering2">{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsaficionado|url=2016/10/behind-scenes-imperial-gathering.html|name=Star Wars Aficionado|text=BEHIND THE SCENES: IMPERIAL GATHERING!}}</ref> [[Trech Molock/Legends|He]] was given the name Trech Molock by the [[2013]] ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' article [[A Certain Point of View (department)|''The Death Star Coup'']].<ref name="SWI">{{InsiderCite|Special Edition 2014|A Certain Point of View|A Certain Point of View: The Death Star Coup}}</ref> The name was brought back to [[canon]] by the short story "[[An Incident Report]]" of the [[2017]] anthology ''[[From a Certain Point of View]]''.<ref name="AIR" />

The character shares his surname<ref name="SWI" /> with [[Sate Pestage|Sate Molock]], an unused character present in the second draft for the [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], who ultimately evolved into [[Sate Pestage]].<ref name="SWAS">''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]''</ref> Molock's given name was inspired by [[Chris Trevas]]'s "''Star Wars'' name" according to an [[Wikipedia:Internet|Internet]] meme, which requires taking the first three letters of one's last name and the first two letters one's first name.<ref name="Trech's Name">{{Facebook|username=StarWarsSourcebooks|url=StarWarsSourcebooks/posts/634665586583552|name=Chris Trevas|date=30-10-2013|quote=Lucasfilm allowed us come up with Molock's first name.|archivefile=File:TrechMolock-Facebook.png}}</ref>

In the early drafts of "[[The Summit]]," the fifteenth episode of the [[The Bad Batch Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'', Molock was supposed to be one of the Imperial officers present at a [[Imperial summit on Eriadu|summit]] held on [[Eriadu]] by Governor Tarkin along with General Cassio Tagge and Admiral Conan Antonio Motti. However, it was eventually decided that the character would not have been high-ranking enough that early in the Empire's existence<ref name="Summit EG">{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/the-summit-episode-guide|text="The Summit" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}}</ref>
